item.title: Brazil's Lencois Maranhenses: dunes and lagoons
item.description: The white sand dunes of Lencois Maranhenses National Park sit between jungle and ocean, featuring freshwater lagoons.

item.title: Zhu Rongji, architect of China's 1990s reforms, dies at 97
item.description: Zhu led reforms transitioning China from Maoist era to a market-oriented financial system, without ceding political control.

item.title: July inflation slows as fuel and food costs decline
item.description: Consumer prices rose 3.4% year-over-year in July, a smaller increase than in May or June, reducing pressure on the Federal Reserve.

item.title: Has the U.S. lost its dominance to China?
